scorecard.rationale: An oral red rice bran oil comparison in haloperidol rats reported less catalepsy, a partial rigidity proxy. The water-control comparison showed a smaller opposite sign, the results wording and figure markings differ, and the oil refining is undocumented. The model-specific contrast weakly favors easing. Human Parkinson rigidity with refined oil remains untested. The verified 2015 extracted rice bran oil experiment measured chewing stereotypies and rotarod performance. Its overlapping companion reports do not supply separately measured clinical rigidity or dystonia.
